text:
alex: Postmortem follow-up (PM-2026-21). Dropping a compact handoff and verification plan. Please claim owners or request swaps in 36h. Actions below include suggested RACI and a short verification format.

1) Throttle + per-model limiter (JIRA-9810) - suggested owner: mei - ETA 7d
2) Canary gate + automated rollback hook (JIRA-9811) - suggested owner: rob + eng-deploy (Consulted) - ETA 5d
3) Runbook rewrite + tabletop (JIRA-9812) - suggested owner: sandra - ETA 3d
4) KV eviction recurrence fingerprinting (JIRA-9813) - suggested owner: mei - ETA 4d
5) Postmortem automation: add recurrence flag + weekly ledger card (internal) - suggested owner: alex - ETA 2d

mei: Ack JIRA-9810 and 9813. I'll start with a quickstop feature-flagged limiter and a p99 dashboard. Will attach traces and flamegraphs to 9813 by Tue.

rob: I'll take JIRA-9811. Proposed RACI: Rob (R), eng-deploy (C), Alex (A), Mei (I). I'll open a subtask for the rollback smoke harness.

sandra: I can own 9812. I'll draft the tabletop script and a short verification checklist to be added to the runbook.

ops-bot: Created subtask JIRA-9811.1 for canary smoke harness: https://jira.redwood.local/browse/JIRA-9811.1

alex: Two process asks: a) when a remediation crosses teams, create one subtask per team and RACI that subtask; b) require a "remediation-verification" comment with the exact format below before PM close.

alex: Verification format (please copy/paste into the ticket comment):

remediation-verification: SHA=<git-sha> smoke=<smoke-id> notes=<short note> traces=<link>

mei: I'll include time-series snapshots and a short reproduction script in 9813. If staging repro fails, I'll request a short pairing session with infra.

rob: I'll add rollback criteria: canary fails if p99 > baseline*1.4 for 15m OR error-rate > 0.5%. Canary default duration 25m.

sandra: PR to ops-runbooks incoming with tabletop + verification checklist. I'll include a sample filled verification comment so PMs know what to expect.

alex: I'll wire the automation to add a weekly "recurrence-review" ledger card for any PM flagged >2 occurrences. Also adding a short owner-handoff matrix template to the PM board.

mei: Ack. I'll update JIRA-9810 and 9813 with RACI and ETAs.

rob: Acked. Opening subtask for harness now and pinging eng-deploy.

sandra: PR posted: https://github.com/redwood/ops-runbooks/pull/1199 - adds verification template and a tabletop script.

alex: If no swaps requested, I'll close owner assignment in 36h and mark owners in the PM ticket. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:

rob: Quick ask: if remediations are larger than 3d, please break them into "quickstop" + "full-remediation" subtasks so we can ship a mitigation early.

alex: Agreed. Add subtasks and tag me if you need help splitting scope. Closing assignments in 36h unless someone asks to swap.
